revision: 1. Typography & Hierarchy: Unify the exhibition title 'ECHOES of the UNSEEN' into a single serif typeface family, using weight (Bold/Regular) and scale for hierarchy instead of mixing italics or sans-serifs. Elevate the artist name 'ELARA VANCE' to a primary header status by increasing font size, weight, and contrast (switch from faint yellow to high-contrast white or light grey), ensuring immediate legibility. 2. Information Architecture: Relocate 'Opening Hours' and 'Location' from the hidden footer to a dedicated, high-visibility information block adjacent to the 'Reserve Tickets' action. Ensure these logistical details use a consistent, legible sans-serif or secondary serif style with sufficient brightness against the dark background. 3. Visual Atmosphere & CTA: Enhance the central SVG artwork with a subtle radial gradient glow or noise texture to create depth and focal distinctiveness against the dark void, preventing it from blending into the background. Replace the stark, corporate white 'Reserve Tickets' button with a high-contrast 'ghost' style (transparent fill, thick white border) or a textured variant that aligns with the experimental, fragmented theme while maintaining clear call-to-action visibility.
protected_strengths: The immersive, dark visual atmosphere and abstract geometric artwork concept.
The strong typographic hierarchy of the main exhibition title.
The clean, grid-based alignment structure that supports legibility.
resolved_conflicts: Conflict: Atmospheric minimalism vs. Mandatory Information Visibility. Resolution: Prioritize legibility by moving logistical data (Hours/Location) out of the footer and increasing contrast/size of the Artist Name, ensuring essential info is found within seconds without sacrificing the dark mood.

Conflict: Experimental Expression vs. System Consistency. Resolution: Unify the title typography to a single family to reduce visual noise, while using expressive SVG effects (glow/texture) and a stylized CTA button to maintain the 'experimental' identity without arbitrary font switching.

Conflict: Flat Design vs. Focal Distinctiveness. Resolution: Add depth to the SVG artwork via gradients/textures to create a visual anchor, and soften the CTA button's corporate harshness with a ghost style, balancing the 'flat' aesthetic with necessary focal contrast.
rationale: This brief weighs all four mandates equally by resolving the tension between 'atmospheric immersion' and 'immediate legibility' through strategic placement and contrast rather than deletion. It resolves 'unity' conflicts by standardizing typography while preserving 'variety' through expressive SVG treatments and a stylized CTA, ensuring the design is both cohesive and distinctive.
